svg.title: Single-pass causal spectral protection
svg.text: The protector learns how to reshape each arriving spectrum.
Only analysis, a causal predictor, bounded gains and waveform reconstruction run during the call.
Persistent streaming state: analysis buffer + GRU hidden state + synthesis overlap buffer
Methods §2.2 / implementation §3.2 · Spectral features are left unspecified in the manuscript · Gain bounds ≠ perceptual guarantee.
